question: In November 2024, Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) started the country’s first analogue space mission at which of the following places to simulate life in an interplanetary habitat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Leh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In November 2024, the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) initiated the country's first analogue space mission in **Leh**.
 
• The mission aims to simulate life in an interplanetary habitat to prepare for future deep space missions.
 
• Leh was chosen due to its harsh terrain and extreme weather conditions, which closely mimic the Martian environment.
 
• This mission is part of ISRO's broader strategy to enhance its capabilities in human spaceflight and interplanetary exploration.
 
• It is a significant step towards understanding the complexities of living and working in space over extended periods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Analogue Space Mission:**

 
 
• These are simulations conducted on Earth to mimic the conditions astronauts would face in space.
 
• They help in understanding the physical and psychological challenges of long-duration space missions.
 
 
 
• **Human Spaceflight:**
 
 
• It involves sending humans into space and ensuring their safe return to Earth.
 
• ISRO's Gaganyaan mission is an example of India's effort in human spaceflight.
 
 
 
• **Interplanetary Exploration:**
 
 
• This refers to the exploration of planets and other celestial bodies within our solar system.
 
• Missions like Mangalyaan (Mars Orbiter Mission) have marked ISRO's entry into interplanetary exploration.
 
 
 
• **ISRO's Future Plans:**
 
 
• ISRO is working on various projects including Chandrayaan-3 and the Aditya-L1 mission to study the Sun.
 
• There are plans for more advanced missions to explore outer space and possibly land on other planets.
